packages.name: @fusorb/facet-utils
packages.description: Shared styling utilities for Facet packages (cn).

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-components
packages.summary: 112 styled UI components on Radix primitives
packages.description: Radix-based UI component library: 113 accessible, styled components using the Alpha Palette design tokens

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-docs
packages.summary: Router-agnostic docs engine with content compiler
packages.description: Installable, config-driven documentation site engine: component gallery with variant pages, per-variant usage tabs, install tabs, and an optional ecosystem links section. Mount <DocsApp config={...} /> with your own brand, pages, and nav.

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-auth
packages.summary: Auth domain: context, flows, 7 form-based components
packages.description: Domain-customizable auth components: ArcProvider, SignIn/SignUp, Guard, MfaDialog, and 5 domain presets (fintech, med, edu, enterprise, default). Wired to @fusorb/facet-sdk.

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-layout
packages.description: Domain-configurable app shell: Sidebar, Topbar, AuthLayout, ConsoleLayout, LandingLayout, PageHeader, TenantSwitcher, and 5 domain presets (fintech, med, edu, enterprise, default).

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-sdk
packages.description: SovGrant API client: framework-agnostic fetch SDK. Auth, credentials, passkeys, OAuth, tenants, billing, webhooks, audit, IdP.

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-tokens
packages.summary: Design tokens: CSS custom properties + Tailwind theme
packages.description: Design tokens: Alpha Palette colors, typography, spacing, surfaces, and sub-brand accents in OKLCH, as CSS variables and a Tailwind v4 theme.

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-emails
packages.description: Framework-agnostic email template renderer: render React or plain template trees to email-safe HTML and text, with template primitives and a dev preview server. Zero runtime dependencies.

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-cli
packages.description: facet CLI: scaffold docs + email template sites, add components, generate tree-shaken icon registries, and audit/update your facet setup from the terminal.

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-store
packages.summary: Zustand-backed state management keyed on SDK session
packages.description: Framework-agnostic state stores for SovGrant auth: Zustand session + tenant state, token-refresh wiring, and hooks consumable across web and React Native. No React coupling in the store logic itself; consumers bring their own React for the auto-generated hooks.

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-motion
packages.summary: Declarative animation system with semantic families
packages.description: Domain-customizable animation engine: generator-driven core (tween + spring), observable motion values, CSS driver with prefers-reduced-motion, a 15-family generative registry, and thin React bindings. Wired to @fusorb/facet-tokens CSS custom properties.

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-native
packages.description: React Native motion driver for @fusorb/facet-motion - subscribes facet motion values to a consumer-provided Animated module (react-native or reanimated v2) via bindAnimated().

packages.name: @fusorb/facet-sandbox
packages.summary: Interactive lab kit: live JSX runtime + stage/inspector
packages.description: Framework-agnostic live-preview sandbox host: block registry, adapter seam, security helpers. Ships no framework code; the React adapter ships under /react.
